name: Quake II — fast preview (experimental)
summary: Experimental: compile, a rough visibility pass and no supersampling. For looking at what you just built.
description:
The quickest Quake II build that still produces something an engine will load: qbsp, a fast vis pass and unsupersampled lighting on one thread.

One thread is not a performance choice. Measured on 2.0.0-alpha7, three runs of one map at four threads produced three different BSPs and one thread produced the same one three times, so a preview built this way can be compared byte-for-byte with the last one. A preview whose output changes when nothing changed is a preview that cannot answer 'did my edit do anything'.

There are no vis or light logs among the outputs: 2.x writes them beside the BSP it was handed, inside the staged input's own directory, and each step's job holds the same text anyway.

The fast vis pass is rough on purpose and is not what you ship. “Quake II — normal build” is.

Quake II support in Auto-Pigeon is work in progress. Some textures, entities, compilation and engine workflows may be incomplete.
